spec: R1 frozen registry + R2 reference-ensemble label + R3 censoring gate

registry.hash: sha256 over the canonical serialization of the registry arrays

label_statuses.COMPLETE: at least K_min distinct later solutions and sigma_ref <= |r|
label_statuses.CENSORED_INSUFFICIENT_REFERENCES: fewer than K_min distinct later solutions in the closure window
label_statuses.AMBIGUOUS_HIGH_SPREAD: at least K_min solutions but sigma_ref > |r|; retained with its uncertainty, never deleted
label_statuses.INVALID_SOURCE_METADATA: missing or untrustworthy CREATION_DATE, unparseable element, or SGP4 non-convergence

labelled_set_definition: COMPLETE union AMBIGUOUS_HIGH_SPREAD -- both carry a computable ensemble label. Completeness is reported BOTH ways (COMPLETE-only and labelled) and the stricter reading is used for the gate.

ensemble.distinctness: distinct physical_element_key (mean elements + drag); same-epoch revisions canonicalized by the pre-existing deterministic earliest-published rule
ensemble.propagation: each qualified solution propagated by SGP4 to t_tx
ensemble.label: D_ref_ens(t_tx) = median_q D_ref,q(t_tx)
ensemble.training_eligibility: t_close <= t_refresh of the model being fitted
forbidden: choosing the later solution that minimizes residual error
deleting rows because ensemble spread is large
ensemble.terminology: r is the ENSEMBLE-REFERENCED INTER-TLE RESIDUAL, never 'the SGP4 residual'

censoring_gate.selection_bias_diagnostic: absolute standardized mean difference between labelled and censored rows
censoring_gate.on_failure: return UNRESOLVED and stop before model training

visibility_diagnostics_R4.reference_consensus_elevation: computed after labelling, diagnostic only, never creates or deletes a row

uncertainty_sensitivity_R7.A_primary: unweighted evaluation over the labelled set
uncertainty_sensitivity_R7.B_secondary: uncertainty-weighted training and evaluation, weight = 1 / (sigma_ref^2 + eps)
uncertainty_sensitivity_R7.C_restriction: may NOT be used for model selection or for the primary S2 claim
